notes.content: Nursing Basic: Criminal background checks, health insurance, immunizations, medical clearance, and malpractice insurance are required for clinical coursework. Consult the CSULB Catalog and major-specific degree requirements for additional details on Nursing Basic. Prerequisite lab courses taken with an online laboratory during the COVID-19 pandemic will be accepted.
